note: The road width in meters for each OSM highway type, when the road has no width tag (plan 0003, R5). These are first values. I correct them when the screenshots show a wrong width. A road whose name starts with one of hem_name_prefixes is a hẻm. Without a width tag, its width is hem_name_width. A one-way road without a width tag is one carriageway of a divided road: its width is oneway_factor times the table width, and its sidewalk is only at the right side. A link road (for example primary_link) without a width tag is link_width wide. A road with a lanes tag and no width tag is lane_width for each lane, plus the sidewalks.
